Uniform programs

Built around quote-ready production details.

Custom Staff Name Badges should be specified around actual use: artwork, size, material, finish, attachment, quantity, packing and whether each piece uses different text or serial data. Clear details reduce quoting time and help the first sample match the bulk order.

BadgeCraft Metalworks supports OEM production for North America, Canada and Europe orders. The usual starting MOQ is 100 pieces per design, sample time is about 7 days after artwork approval, and bulk production is about 15 days after sample confirmation.

  • Common materials: stainless steel, aluminum, brass or zinc alloy.
  • Surface options: brushed metal, polished metal, black coating, engraving or digital printing.
  • Attachment or mounting: magnet, pin, clip or adhesive backing.
  • Typical starting MOQ: 100 pieces per design, adjusted by process.
  • Sample lead time: about 7 days after artwork approval.
  • Bulk production: about 15 days after sample approval.
  • Accepted artwork files: PSD, PDF and editable vector files when available.

FAQ

Custom Staff Name Badges questions.

Can each staff badge have a different name?

Yes. Send the name list in Excel with title, department and branch if needed.

Can staff name badges be reordered later?

Yes. Approved artwork and layout can be kept as a reorder template.

Which backing should we choose?

Magnetic backing is common for uniforms, while pin or clip backs may reduce cost for basic use.
